rationale:
Issue #1194 (embedded verbatim in source_candidate.issue_check.linked_issues) reports that swift-format collapses the line following a shebang onto the shebang line, producing '#!/usr/bin/env swift  // (c) Acme Inc.' and breaking idempotency. The commit message and PR #1207 body identify the same mechanism: the newline terminating the shebang is stored as leading trivia on the first statement, and orderImports(in:) treats it as a leading blank line of the file header and drops it. The minimized production patch matches that diagnosis exactly: hunk 1 adds a guarded block in OrderedImports.visit(_ node: SourceFileSyntax) that restores the difference in leading newlines when node.shebang != nil and statements are non-empty; hunk 2 adds the private leadingNewlineCount(of:) helper that hunk 1 calls. Both hunks are mutually dependent and confined to Sources/SwiftFormat/Rules/OrderedImports.swift; there is no refactor, reformatting, feature extension, doc-only, or config-only content, and no public API surface is added or changed. The trigger is the unmodified upstream test portion of the same single-commit fix (trigger_reduction.upstream_trigger_patch), so it is semantically the reported defect rather than a curator restatement: testShebangWithFileHeaderAndImport and testShebangWithReorderedImports assert shebang-preserving behavior through the pre-existing assertFormatting harness, and testHashBangFollowedByLineComment reproduces the issue text through pre-existing public APIs (SwiftFormatter.format, Parser.parse, OperatorTable.standardOperators, Configuration.forTesting). None of the tests reference the newly added private leadingNewlineCount helper, and strict evidence confirms all three selectors compile and fail on the buggy parent 68e501b, which independently rules out dependence on a fix-introduced production API. Strict gates pass identically before and after minimization: build.both_versions, selectors.present_and_unique (3/3 valid and unique), trigger.buggy_differential with all three selectors reproduced, trigger.fixed_clean, trigger.deterministic (5 fingerprint groups over 3 repetitions, 44 matrix runs), full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers, and full_suite.fixed_all_green with no baseline exclusions and zero failed_checks. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so this root cause duplicates no active registry entry, and swiftlang/swift-format#1194 is the sole allowed verified issue key.

Issue #1194 reports that swift-format collapses the line following a shebang onto the shebang line ('#!/usr/bin/env swift  // (c) Acme Inc.'), producing invalid output and breaking idempotency on previously valid input. The commit message and PR #1207 body identify the same mechanism: the newline terminating the shebang is stored as leading trivia on the first statement, and orderImports(in:) treats it as a leading blank line of the file header and drops it. The minimized production patch is exactly two additive hunks in Sources/SwiftFormat/Rules/OrderedImports.swift: a restoration block inside the existing visit(_ node: SourceFileSyntax) guarded by node.shebang != nil, non-empty statements, and updated < original; plus a private leadingNewlineCount(of:) helper. No public API is added or changed, no reformatting, no config or docs touched, and the behavior change is confined to the shebang path. The trigger patch is the unchanged upstream test portion of the same commit: OrderedImportsTests.testShebangWithFileHeaderAndImport and testShebangWithReorderedImports use the pre-existing assertFormatting harness with inline string fixtures, and GarbageTextTests.testHashBangFollowedByLineComment drives the pre-existing public SwiftFormatter/Parser/OperatorTable pipeline; none depend on the private helper introduced by the fix, and testShebangWithReorderedImports still asserts the normal 'sort import statements lexicographically' finding, guarding against over-correction. Strict machine evidence reports all gates green with no failed checks: build.both_versions, trigger.buggy_differential reproducing all three declared selectors, trigger.fixed_clean, trigger.deterministic (5 of 5 fingerprint groups), full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers, full_suite.fixed_all_green, and post-minimization validation PASS with 2 of 2 hunks retained. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and swiftlang/swift-format#1194 is the sole allowed key, so no duplicate root cause exists.

risks: case.json issue_evidence and semantic_justification are null; the issue text was read from the embedded source_candidate payload rather than a separately fetched issue record.

testHashBangFollowedByLineComment exercises the whole SwiftFormatter pipeline rather than OrderedImports alone, so its failure is not by itself proof of rule-level isolation; the two OrderedImportsTests selectors carry that isolation.

The commit message references an earlier fix that special-cased files with no imports, but the diff is purely additive, so whether any remnant of that special case remains in the tree is not visible in the supplied patches.
The trigger tests use try! around parse and format, so an unexpected failure in that path would surface as a crash rather than a clean assertion, which could complicate future re-validation.
Idempotency, which the issue also reports as broken, is only covered indirectly by the expected-output assertions; no explicit double-format assertion is present.
